description: This file implements a traverser for translating shader storage buffer object (SSBO) access chains into offsets within HLSL shader code, specifically for the ANGLE project. It includes functions for handling block layout info, mapping variables to fields, and generating HLSL code for SSBO access chains.

classes.name: ShaderStorageBlockOutputHLSL
classes.description: A class responsible for traversing shader code to generate HLSL code for shader storage buffer object (SSBO) access chains, including handling of block layout and atomic operations.

classes.name: BlockInfoVisitor
classes.description: A helper class for collecting block member information during traversal of shader storage blocks.

methods.name: GetBlockLayoutInfo
methods.description: Retrieves layout information for a block based on a shader variable node.

methods.name: GetBlockMemberInfoByType
methods.description: Encodes type information for a block member based on its type, storage, and layout.

methods.name: GetFieldMemberInShaderStorageBlock
methods.description: Finds a field within a shader storage block by variable name.

methods.name: FindInterfaceBlock
methods.description: Finds an interface block in a list by matching its name.

methods.name: StripArrayIndices
methods.description: Removes array index notation from a variable name string.

methods.name: MapVariableToField
methods.description: Recursively maps shader variables to their corresponding TField in a struct.

methods.name: GetShaderStorageBlockMembersInfo
methods.description: Collects information about members of a shader storage block.

methods.name: IsInArrayOfArraysChain
methods.description: Checks if a node is part of an array-of-arrays chain.

methods.name: ShaderStorageBlockOutputHLSL
methods.description: Main class for generating HLSL code for SSBO access chains, including handling of various access methods and code emission.

methods.name: outputStoreFunctionCallPrefix
methods.description: Outputs the prefix for a store function call in HLSL.

methods.name: outputLoadFunctionCall
methods.description: Outputs a load function call in HLSL.

methods.name: outputLengthFunctionCall
methods.description: Outputs a length function call in HLSL.

methods.name: outputAtomicMemoryFunctionCallPrefix
methods.description: Outputs atomic memory function call prefix based on the operation.

methods.name: setMatrixStride
methods.description: Calculates and sets the matrix stride for a node.

methods.name: traverseSSBOAccess
methods.description: Traverses an SSBO access chain node to generate corresponding HLSL code.

methods.name: writeShaderStorageBlocksHeader
methods.description: Outputs header information for shader storage blocks.

methods.name: isEndOfSSBOAccessChain
methods.description: Determines if the current node is at the end of an SSBO access chain.

methods.name: visitSymbol
methods.description: Handles visiting a symbol node during traversal.

methods.name: visitConstantUnion
methods.description: Handles visiting a constant union node.

methods.name: visitAggregate
methods.description: Handles visiting an aggregate node.

methods.name: visitTernary
methods.description: Handles visiting a ternary node.

methods.name: visitUnary
methods.description: Handles visiting a unary node.

methods.name: visitSwizzle
methods.description: Handles visiting a swizzle node.

methods.name: visitBinary
methods.description: Handles visiting a binary node.

methods.name: writeEOpIndexDirectOrIndirectOutput
methods.description: Generates code for direct or indirect index operations in SSBOs.

methods.name: writeDotOperatorOutput
methods.description: Outputs dot operator notation for struct fields.
